verdicts.summary: The roster is read at ProviderSessionManager.ts:1066, before subscribers are failed (1081) and the scope closes (1086). The code doesn't show whether the adapter can still report new tasks, or write a stale full-row `provider-thread.updated`, between the read and the close. I did not read the event-pump path.
verdicts.missing: Whether the Claude or Muse event pump can still persist roster changes after line 1066. A task added after the snapshot would not be in `taskIds`, so the thread would stay Waiting. A pump write that carries an older roster after the cleanup would restore the cleared tasks. The code that consumes adapter events and writes provider threads would settle this.

verdicts.summary: The only hazard in the CAS is the byte-for-byte compare of stored `payload_json` against a re-encoded decoded row. Finding 0 already states this.
Claude and Muse both declare `supportsMultipleProviderThreadsPerSession: false`. A session therefore has at most one attached thread, and `attachedThreadIds` plus the detached thread covers it.
verdicts.scenario: A thread detaches earlier from a multi-thread session and the session is released later. That needs a multi-thread runtime that sets `backgroundTasksEndWithProcess`. The only runtime with multi-thread support is the opencode v2 adapter (`provider-opencode/src/server/v2/adapter.ts:107`), and it does not opt in.
